mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 1.68% is historically low, compressing discount rates and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is within 0.1% of 1.68% (i.e., 1.58% to 1.78%).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 295.5 signals persistent inflation, triggering central bank tightening and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 295.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL (FEDFUNDS > 1.6% and CPIAUCSL > 295) signals tightening monetary policy and inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (FEDFUNDS > 1.6% and CPIAUCSL > 295) is met, but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), tight labor market conditions support corporate earnings growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST < 1550) signal weakening residential demand, reducing economic growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST falls below 1550.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 104) signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO falls below 104.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declining HOUST and RSAFS (HOUST < 1560 and RSAFS < 681000) signals a housing market collapse, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (HOUST < 1560 and RSAFS < 681000) is met, but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in private sector employment (PAYEMS < 152500) signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS falls below 152500.
